steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Ahead is the tunnel where we first found Oka.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It should have been placed under lockdown soon after... but now, it looks completely abandoned.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: The good news is that Originium particle activity has also dropped after work stopped. Infection risk should be minimal as long as you do not touch the deactivated Originium crystals.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'm not detecting any other lifeforms. We should be able to get in without a fight.

options: We still don't know what happened here.
The Patrol Units and guards could return any time.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you sure this is the right way, Ksenia?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I don't see anything.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Sorry. I've only been down here once before...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Let me find the emergency power switch.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Here it is.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Ok, looks like this is the right way. All we need to do is to go in the opposite direction from the mine carts.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Opposite direction? I thought we're going deeper.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It leads to somewhere other than the mine tunnels. I don't know what it's actually for, but the carts only carry goods, not people.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What about the cart? Can we use it?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: There are no structural issues, but it's been abandoned for so long that there's only enough emergency power for the lights. I don't think it's a good idea.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You two, get on the cart.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Get on, Doctor. We can save time that way.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But it won't start—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Do you need me to lift you up, Doctor?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you ready?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What are you planning—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: —Whoa?!

options: We'll be thrown off the cart.
The cart's going to fall apart.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It'll be fine. Just sit tight.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Here we go!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Thank goodness the tunnels look intact.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But we should have started a fire before coming down... it's a lot wetter than the outside. The difference is almost as great as the Iberian coast compared to inland Ursus.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Of course, there is a dramatic difference in temperature as well... are you alright?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'm fine. What about you, Doctor?

options: Every part of my brain feels equally shaken.
You looked like you enjoyed it, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I kept the speed steady.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Mon3tr is a very good cart driver. Or cart pusher.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Sounds like the problem's not on my end.

options: When was Oka first discovered in the mines?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I'm not sure exactly when. The first sample arrived at the lab a month ago.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: That was when I learned of the appearance of this heretofore unheard-of substance in the Originium mines.

options: This substance that appeared in the mines...
What made the lab decide to perform human experiments?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Infected exposed to Oka in this tunnel were subject to unusual mutations.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Their infection readings soared, but their vital signs remained stable, 'healthy' even...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: That sounds familiar.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Have you encountered other patients like this? Have they come into contact with Oka?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: In any case... the Ursine government wanted to replicate the 'miracle'.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I suppose they wanted a docile labor force that did not fear illness or pain... perhaps even employ them in combat.

options: I'm not surprised the government would react that way...
They haven't realized the potential danger.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I think we're getting close.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This is as far as the rail goes. We'll have to proceed on foot.
The three of you move forward in the darkness.
You hear before you see. It is the heavy sound of water.
The three of you look up and slowly open your eyes.
You soon realize that the light in the tunnel is not coming from outside. It is coming from the stationary liquid in front of you on the ground—and the 'waterfall' at the very end.
It glitters like obsidian, refracting light from a crack high above as it falls, making the cave bright as early morning after a shower.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: You can tell?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Yes. Like an obsequent river, the Oka cannot flow outwards along the dip, so it can only flow backwards, until it lies 'still' like this.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But it continues to flow in a way, even without external forces acting on it. That's why they named it 'Oka'—river.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The liquid is everywhere.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's like a natural karst cave. You can't even tell that it used to be a mine.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Even stranger, Oka itself is almost like water.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Well... in a manner of speaking.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Oka becomes highly stable after it is allowed to stand still for a while. It can even be used as a universal solvent.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Wait! We still shouldn't touch it with bare hands—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Oh...
Mon3tr bends over and collects some liquid with a test tube. She is not wearing gloves, or any other form of protection.
Her expression grows solemn as she shakes the liquid in the test tube with wet hands.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: You should not touch it directly—I have protective equipment. You can tell me if you want a sample, and I'll collect it!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Whisper) Doctor... I know what this is.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What?

options: Can you get some samples from around the waterfall?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Wait here. I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: ...Be careful.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This liquid that they call Oka... it's Originium.

options: Why does it look that way?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's complicated.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Do you remember the 'Transmitter' that Rhine Lab was studying, or the 'Corazonix' that is often mentioned in Iberian alchemy?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This is their prototype... or perhaps I should say, the original form.

options: What the Transmitter and Corazonix have in common...
They both serve as a kind of medium.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Yes. A medium that reacts directly with the human body, or to store information.

options: So that's why they are both liquid?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I think so...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You understand, Doctor, that Originium is both a vehicle for information, and a vehicle for energy.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Both the Transmitter and Corazonix re-record Originium energy through specific means, in order to record different types of information.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Oka here is the remnant of Originium, after its energy was extracted in an even more effective manner.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: So it's really a form of 'universal solvent', and this explains why the Infected who came into contact with Oka became 'mutated'.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Because of its nature as drained Originium, Oka neutralizes the Originium activity inside the Infected, while creating the perfect conditions for the continued growth of Originium.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It allowed the Infected to retain their vital functions temporarily, but does not change the fact that death would inevitably follow soon.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Meanwhile, all the uninfected individuals injected with Oka died of severe rejection, due to the lack of active Originium in their bodies...

options: Its presence here in such quantities...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This is what we feared the most...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Kolossal Prime Vein is drying up.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The rumors we heard, that Ursus is accelerating the extraction of Originium... it's all to hide the exhaustion of the ore vein.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It began here in the northmost parts of Ursus, and it will only accelerate.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Within four months, the Originium deposits in Ursus will drop to thirty percent of previous levels.

options: This is the real reason why the Grand Duchess put the mining district on lockdown.

steps.text: You did not need to ask the question. One gaze exchanged with Mon3tr, and both of you have the same name in mind.
The only one who could have done this—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: There's no one else.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The exhaustion of the ore vein cannot be stopped or reversed.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Ursus will collapse.

options: Exhaustion on such a scale will have ramifications across Terra.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I have an idea!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Oka is also a relic of the old civilization... a by-product of your experiments.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: If she caused the exhaustion of the ore vein, then there might be some useful information left within.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: See if you can read it.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Our means are limited. You'll have to insert your hand, like I did when I collected the sample.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Don't worry, it won't harm you.
Following Mon3tr's instructions, you crouch down and immerse your hands into the liquid Oka.
You wait.

options: You do not feel any different.

steps.text: You await some kind of change, or response, like the 'miracles' that happened so many times before.
Nothing happened.
The product of a previous civilization seems to reject you, denying your connection to it.

options: Could it be that it has already lost its ability to hold information?
Or perhaps, she had no intention of leaving any information to us.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's possible.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Mon3tr! Doctor!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Come! I found something!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: There's a hole behind the waterfall. When I climbed up and stood there—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I heard a sound of an unusual frequency from the cave. It didn't seem natural—no, it definitely isn't natural!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It's like... it's trying to communicate some sort of information through audio waves!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This is—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: This space was hidden behind the waterfall?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Listen carefully to the sound of the liquid impacting the rocks! Some of the sounds are of a particular frequency, like it's trying to draw attention to itself. It's very different, and you can definitely tell.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I tried to decipher the ones I heard. It took a while to record the various pitches—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: There! Did you hear that?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: All I hear is the rain! I can't even hear you speak—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor?
You close your eyes and allow yourself to be immersed in sound.
Until you identify the sound that is constantly changing in frequency.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: —Did you say you hear it—
The sound rushes into your consciousness. Sometimes it is formed from several high frequencies, sometimes it is short and sharp, like a meticulous music score.
You soon realize that it represents some sort of code, or perhaps language.
You try to recall all the languages that you know, categorizing them in your mind, and you soon realize that you are hearing the same word, just in different languages.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I've copied it down...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It's just a hunch, but if we decipher it using the standard encoding for communication between nomadic cities...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I think it's referring to the same word, in many different languages. I could identify Ursine and Gaulish from it! I think they both mean—
Upon the rocks, the liquid in the mine is communicating the same word at you—
Yes, Dr. {@nickname}.
If you still believe you made the right choice.
If you still believe in the future you described.
Then refute me with reality, and prove to me...
That thing which you hold so firm...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Whisper) You think it's a message from Priestess?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We'll go back to the lab once Ksenia has gathered her samples.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We must try to contact Amiya...

options: I wonder how Amiya's team is doing.
I hope Amiya has made contact with Raidian.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What sound?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The waterfall is pretty loud.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you sure it's not just your ears ringing? Perhaps lingering effects from having to process too much information just now...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Ksenia? Is that you?

options: It's not Ksenia's footsteps. Not the right weight or rhythm.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What's... that—
Frenzied crying, frenetic breathing, thick mucous liquid dripping from the fangs.
Its entire body is covered in a hard layer of dark-red Originium, forcing it to stand on its two hind legs.
You see it raise its front paws—
Not paws. A pair of withered hands, indistinguishable from that of a human.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I have the samples!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Why are you just standing there?
The strange manglerbeast, which seems so removed from reality, is right behind her.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Run, Ksenia! Don't look back!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'll get her. Go to the mine cart, Doctor, and we'll meet you there!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What—
The researcher cannot help but look back as she starts running.
She hardly has the time to swallow her scream.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Gosudar-batyushka—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What is that thing?!
